property_summary: For any bytes32 identifier, calling assertionDisputedCallback and then calling getPrice(identifier, time, ancillaryData) on the reference C yields a revertless call whose returned int256 is equal to 0 (reference's default view returns nothing / treated as 0 observable), whereas the mutant exposes int256(uint256(identifier)) for some identifiers so the observed return differs — the test checks that getPrice called via an external call returns 0 for all identifiers (the reference behavior) and the mutant will fail for identifiers whose truncated int256 is non-zero.
change_summary: Changed getPrice to return the hash of identifier truncated to int256 (int256(uint256(identifier))).
